topic: What actually happens when you tap your card
title: What Really Happens When You Tap Your Card
title_alt: Your Money Never Moves When You Tap Your Card
description:
You tap your card, the machine beeps, and the payment is done in two seconds. But not a single cent actually moves. This is what really happens inside that tap: the chip has no battery, it steals power from the terminal, whispers one encrypted code, and your bank does not open a vault - it edits a number.

Which means the money in your account is not sitting in a box with your name on it. It is a promise. And when the promise breaks, that is when a bank dies.
